title: Do Companies Deliver on Their IPO Claims?
abstract: arXiv:2611.27273v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Initial public offering (IPO) filings describe what a company does and what it intends to become. Yet whether individual forward-looking claims are subsequently realized is difficult to assess. We introduce Vision Follow-Through (VFT), a benchmark and agentic pipeline that separates claim extraction, category assignment, verifiability, and evidence-grounded follow-through assessment. \vftclaims{} contains 5,066 human-annotated claim spans from 50 IPO filings, while \vftverify{} adds verifiability tiers, follow-through outcomes, and cited later evidence for 1,000 claims. Across language models, classifying human-annotated claims is substantially easier than extracting claims from full filings. Extraction coverage also varies sharply by category, with Organizational/Culture claims recovered far less often than Market Opportunity claims. translated_abstract: 首次公开募股（IPO）招股书描述了一家公司的业务内容及其未来愿景。然而，评估单个前瞻性声明是否在随后得到实现是困难的。我们提出了 Vision Follow-Through（VFT），这是一个基准测试和智能体流程，将声明提取、类别分配、可验证性判断以及基于证据的兑现评估分离开来。\vftclaims{} 包含来自50份IPO招股书的5,066个人工标注的声明片段，而 \vftverify{} 为其中1,000个声明添加了可验证性层级、兑现结果以及引用的后续证据。在各类语言模型上，对人工标注的声明进行分类远比从完整招股书中提取声明容易。提取覆盖率也因类别而显著不同，组织/文化类声明的提取率远低于市场机会类声明。兑现评估则构成另一个独立的挑战：模型的判断与人类评估存在分歧……
tldr: 该论文提出了Vision Follow-Through（VFT）基准，用于评估公司在IPO招股书中做出的前瞻性声明是否真正兑现，发现模型在从完整招股书中提取声明以及评估声明兑现情况方面仍面临显著挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Vision Follow-Through (VFT), a benchmark for evaluating whether companies' forward-looking claims in IPO filings are actually realized, revealing that language models struggle with claim extraction from full filings and with follow-through assessment.
